Interview: War crimes researcher Shahriar
2014-11-28T00:00:11+06:00 | Zaid Kalam
https://www.thedailystar.net/war-crimes-researcher-shahriar-part-1-55383

Writer, historian and war crimes researcher Shahriar Kabir talks about the challenges and scopes of documenting the historical facts of the Liberation War in 1971.

This interview in three parts was first published on our Freedom in the Air repository in November 28, 2014 .
